thesis: This episode primarily serves as a historical overview of the AI industry's evolution, highlighting key figures and companies like NVIDIA, OpenAI, and Anthropic that have been shaped by the microchip era. It argues that major corporations such as Netflix and TikTok are currently leveraging AI for personalized user experiences, while noting that NVIDIA is expected to continue scaling its H-100 chip production.
